title: symplocos cochinchinensis subsp. leptophylla
intro: Symplocos cochinchinensis subsp. leptophylla, commonly known as the Small-leaved Symplocos or Symplocos leptophylla, is a plant species in the family Symplocaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Symplocos cochinchinensis subsp. leptophylla include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant activities, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and free radical scavenging properties.
